covered.text: An introduction to order planning — MRP — in Infor LN, using the bamboo training items (BAM-CHOP-PAIR, BAM-ROD, BAM-SLEEVE) built in earlier sessions. It works forward from what an item needs before LN will plan it at all, through where demand comes from, to the single setting that decides which demand planning is willing to act on. It closes with a short look at master planning.

tokens.v: Why it exists: with an unlimited horizon, planning would tell you to start supplying demand a year or two out. A business often does not want that — the demand may still change, and the capacity may not be there.

items.text: Planned orders are suggestions. A planner who knows the supplier will override them — a suggestion to buy 101 makes no sense when the supplier ships in batches of 100, so you buy 200. LN can enforce that as an order-quantity rule on Items - Ordering (tcibd2100m000).
